question: After v4 role-pair labels and literal critical centers are frozen, which center-to-center connection edits preserve structural role, and which connection or path edits distinguish role-broken controls across Cleveland, Bavaria and LOC?

physicalProjection.centerIdentity: same CENTER hash preimage, critical clustering, centroid rounding, arm histogram and tile index as v4
physicalProjection.pixelGraph: union each compiler tile core's thinned skeleton adjacency plus reciprocal overlap-crossing adjacency, then contract anchored v4 critical-center clusters into center-to-center paths
forbiddenClaims: globally unique stroke identity beyond the frozen physical pixels

centerCorrespondence.transformSelection: minimum kind-weighted symmetric nearest-center displacement by cKDTree, ties by listed order
centerCorrespondence.oneToOneCenterMatching: same-kind sparse greedy assignment using each smaller-set center's eight nearest candidates after transform freeze

editObservables.label: fraction of A edges between surviving matched centers whose mapped B connection is absent
fraction of B edges between surviving matched centers with no mapped A connection
normalized multigraph connection symmetric difference after center correspondence
mean normalized parallel-path multiplicity change for corresponding center pairs
mean mapped-neighbor Jaccard mutation around surviving endpoint centers
mean mapped-neighbor Jaccard mutation around surviving junction centers
mean absolute observation-diagonal-normalized path-step mutation among preserved mapped connections
mean absolute tortuosity mutation among preserved mapped connections
mean absolute turn-rate mutation among preserved mapped connections

trainDiscovery.nullShuffle: preserved/broken labels within each physical occupant-family pair preserving positive count
trainDiscovery.selection: largest absolute family-pair-balanced rank effect in Cleveland only

transfer.descriptivePass: same balanced-effect direction in train, holdout and control, with absolute holdout and control effect each at least 0.08

falsifiers.centerMismatch: If the edge projector does not reproduce every v4 center record exactly for all 435 selected observations, the edge world is rejected.
falsifiers.insufficientGraphResolution: If fewer than 80% of center-started stitched paths resolve globally, do not infer a connection grammar from this projector.
falsifiers.noEdgeSignal: If preserved and matched-broken pairs are indistinguishable under Cleveland nulls, no literal connection-edit grammar is supported at this resolution.
falsifiers.noTransfer: If Cleveland-selected edge edits reverse or collapse in Bavaria or LOC, they are not transferable physical syntax constraints.
